column1: # Language identity of Wiktionary translation items (source of truth; edit by hand).
# Read by wiktionary_varieties.py when the dump is parsed (JSONL parser 2.py, wiktionary_extract.py,
# Wiktionary concept index.py). User 2026-11-28: identity by mutual intelligibility, following SIL's
# ISO 639-3 individual languages (offline: langcodes' IANA registry).
#   name  rows: an item filed under `code` whose `lang` field is `name` (Wiktionary sub-lines such as
#               "*: Bavarian:" under German keep the parent code but name the variety)
#   tag   rows: an item carrying tag `name` (old-style dialect tags), whatever its code
#   code  rows: an item filed under the Wiktionary-only code `code` (name is *)
#   same        the language of `code` itself (main name, equivalent names, typos)
#   <ISO code>  an individual language of its own (SIL): the item is filed under that code
#   view:<X>    a variety with no ISO code of its own (mutually intelligible with the language, like
#               GB/US English): kept under the language, tagged view:<X>, shown as a variety view
#   exclude     set aside: a misfiled item whose code and name disagree, or a dialect group that is
# A name under a code listed here that has no row is set aside and reported
